content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves a link collision by summarizing the challenger’s chain in [DR3] and the defender’s chain in [CR2] and [CR3], so it is doing the chain-against-chain thing the rule governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "\"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing\" — one reading requires comparing the footings of the two chains before an UNDERDETERMINED result; the other allows UNDERDETERMINED merely because each side has an answer in its chain.", "why": "The judge declares UNDERDETERMINED only by noting that both sides answered, without weighing the two chains by footing as K-C requires."}
